# Audio contract (read before touching anything that makes or triggers sound)

Owner: the **声音设计** chat. The game's sound runs through FMOD. Gameplay code never plays sound itself: it raises C# events, and the audio layer listens, finds objects by name, and plays FMOD events. If you change any of the hooks below, or need a new sound, message the sound chat first.

## Files the sound chat owns (do not edit or regenerate them)

- `Assets/Scripts/Audio/*`: the runtime audio layer (director, door/foot/Relay components, FMOD helpers).
- `Assets/Editor/Audio/*`: FMOD setup and the bank/code contract check.
- `Assets/Plugins/FMOD/Resources/FMODStudioSettings.asset` and `Assets/Plugins/FMOD/Cache/Editor/FMODStudioCache.asset`:
  - The settings must keep `sourceProjectPath: FMOD/FrontRooms/FrontRooms.fspro`, `sourceBankPath: FMOD/FrontRooms/Build`, `MasterBanks: [Master]` and `Banks: [Ambience, Music, SFX]`.
  - With those empty, FMOD starts but loads nothing.
  - Don't run FMOD's setup wizard. `HideSetupWizard: 1` must stay set: with 0 the wizard reopens after every script reload, and finishing it doesn't save the flag.
- `ProjectSettings/AudioManager.asset`: `m_DisableAudio: 1` (Red's choice in the FMOD setup wizard, 2026-10-02). Unity's built-in audio is off, so no legacy AudioSource can ever be heard; all game sound is FMOD. Don't turn it back on. The legacy code paths below still exist but are silent.
- `Assets/StreamingAssets/FMOD/*.bank`: copies of the built banks that FMOD for Unity writes on bank refresh, used by player builds (Mac and WebGL). Commit them as they are; don't edit or delete them.
- `FMOD/FrontRooms/**`: the FMOD Studio project and its built banks. It is generated by `Tools/audio/fmod_frontrooms.py` + `fmod_builder.js`.
- `AudioSource/**`, `Tools/audio/**`, `Documentation/AUDIO_LICENSES.md`, `Documentation/SOUND_FOLEY_MOTIF_RESEARCH.md`, `Documentation/SOUND_COVERAGE_AUDIT.md`, `Documentation/DOOR_FOLEY_SEGMENTS.md`, `Research/week02/assets/sound-previews/**`, `Research/week02/assets/sound-review/**`.

## Rules for everyone else

1. **No new AudioSources or AudioClips for game moments.** Raise an event (or tell the sound chat where the moment happens), and the sound chat adds the FMOD event and hook.
2. **Don't set `AudioListener.volume` / `AudioListener.pause`.** The director mutes the legacy Unity audio while FMOD runs, and restores it if FMOD fails.
3. **The legacy Unity sounds in `FrontRooms3DGame` / `FrontRoomsFoley` / `FrontRoomsRoomStream` are dead code now** (Unity audio is disabled). Don't add new ones; gate any that remain on `!FrontRooms.Audio.FrontRoomsFmod.Ready`.
4. **Hunter footsteps belong to the rig.** `FrontRoomsRelayRig.Step` drives them; don't add timer steps when FMOD is ready.

## Names the audio layer discovers in the scene

| Object | How it is found | Sound attached |
|---|---|---|
| Manual door hinges | Transform name starts with `Door hinge` (C22's "Door hinge stairwell …" included) | hinge-driven: the latch breakaway (Unlatch) out of the frame and the Swing event while it moves; the handle and the close come from the hooks above (the stairwell's north door: `FrontRoomsStairwell.NorthDoorLatched`); StopLimit only for a real impact at the open limit; nothing for an ease-in or a mid-swing rest. No closer, creak loop, air whump, motor or steel panic bar on a map door. The stairwell's steel Foley lands with 游戏视觉's steel look |
| Title stream double doors | `double door left hinge` (Lead), `double door right hinge` (Follow), siblings under the room root; the 0.9 s / 88° smoothstep in RoomStream | StreamOpen / StreamClose per leaf (683823, a large wooden door: the latch and push as the pair leaves its stop, the close as each leaf lands in its frame from disjoint Lead / Follow takes, Follow 28 ms later; the swing itself is silent; nothing at rest); StreamLock once when `FrontRoomsRoomStream.TerminalDoorShut` (a deadbolt thrown from the far side, 451139); snap-shut recycling is silent |
| Lamps | a `Light` on an object named `Light` or starting with `fluorescent light` | fixture hum, strike / tick events from its intensity |
| Player | the `CharacterController` | footsteps from distance travelled, breath from the stamina rule |
| Listener | the scene's `AudioListener`, or a `StudioListener` (the FMOD wizard may have replaced it) | exactly one enabled FMOD `StudioListener`, on the camera; extras are disabled |
| The Relay | the `FrontRoomsRelayRig` | footsteps (`Step`), heard only at warning stage 2 or in sight; its low drone or hum (W2 and C30, below) |
| Sounding screens (V5) | every `FrontRoomsScreenVideo` whose `SoundRole` is not None, looked up once a second | TitleTV: the WTCZ station loop (`Screen/TitleTV`, 16 s) and the set's 15.7 kHz whine within 2 m (`Screen/Whine`) while the set is on; `Screen/PowerOn` / `PowerOff` when the player switches it; captions `[TV]` (within 8 m, at most every 20 s) and `[TV SWITCHES OFF]`. Beacon (the floor's station TV, S2): the same set in sight; out of sight, from the doorway on the path to it (`FrontRoomsWayfinding.BeaconPath`), level and low-pass from the path; silent with no route |

## How the Relay is heard (C10 / W2, RELAY §9.3–9.4, 2026-10-22)

- **No cue says "near" through walls.** The 2D Hunt/Search/Chase/Lost stingers, the release clicks and the straight-line heartbeat are gone. `Relay/Stinger` and `Relay/Clicks` stay in the banks unused until the v2 cues replace them.
- **Steps** (`FrontRoomsRelaySound`) play only at `WarnStage` ≥ 2 or while `PlayerSeesRelay`, from its real position. `Relay/Footstep` has no straight-line distance attenuation (rolloff Custom).
  - `PathGain` = 0.55 + 0.45 (1 − F/18) in stage 2, fading to 0 between 18 and 24 m, or 0.55 × 18/F in sight past 18 m.
  - `Occlusion` is the muffle, a low-pass only: 0.3 ajar, 0.55 one shut opening, 0.85 two or more, and at least 0.5 × (F − 3)/21.
  - Measured on FMOD renders (`fmod_check.py` `relay_w2`): step peaks are +10 dB over the room tone at the stage-2 entry through a shut door, +15 dB at F 10 m on an open path and +20 dB at F 5 m in sight. The hum is about room-tone level at the entry.
- **C30 switches** (`FrontRoomsSoundDirector.HumByStage`, `TensionByStage`; §13 items 3 and 5; both on in main since 2026-10-22 15:23, Red: "C30 选 1"):
  - `HumByStage` on: the low hum `Relay/Hum` follows the steps' rules and gain, captioned `[LOW HUM]`. Off: the v1 `Relay/Presence` drone plays whenever the Relay is released, from straight-line proximity and the walls between, captioned `[LOW DRONE]`.
  - `TensionByStage` on: Tension follows the stage only (0.05 / 0.2 / 0.4 for stages 0 / 1 / 2, 1.0 in a chase; rise 1/s, fall 0.25/s). Off: the v1 state weight × straight-line proximity.
- **The heartbeat (`Arousal`)** comes from exertion (winded: the slow beat) and the chase (the fast beat, fading over 3 s after it).
- **Captions:**
  - `[MUFFLED HEAVY STEPS]` / `[HEAVY STEPS]` for the steps;
  - `[LOW HUM]` for the hum (C30 on), or `[LOW DRONE]` (C30 off);
  - `[LIGHTS DIP]` for a burst, or `[HUM DROPS]` when it has no lamps.

## The stairwell is a safe zone (Red 2026-10-22; tutorial L11)

Red, 游戏视觉 chat, 15:47: the stairwell is a safe zone and the Relay can't get in. The map side is 关卡设计's (16:05): the player in X is never seen or caught, a chase ends on entry, and the Relay walks to the door, stops 1.2 s (`StoppedAtSafeDoor`) and walks 4 m off (`SafeDoorBeat`) before the seal. While the listener is in X (`InExitArea`), the audio does this:

- **The steps stay real.** `FrontRoomsRelaySound` keeps them audible through `SafeDoorBeat`, whatever the warning stage, so the player hears the Relay come to the door, stop outside and go. X is no map, so no path reaches it: the muffle comes from the EXIT door's own state (`ExitOpeningCost()`: open 0, ajar 0.3, shut 0.55), and the level from the straight-line distance.
- **The stop is marked** by one dragged step (`Relay/Footstep`, `RelayGait` Drag) on `StoppedAtSafeDoor`, at the steps' level and muffle, and only if the steps are audible.
- **Nothing warns.** `Relay/Hum` stops (AHDSR fade), Tension settles to its floor (0.05), and a `WarnBurst` plays no groan, note or caption.
- **The stairwells sound like block and steel** (Zone `Stair`, label 4, append-only; 2026-10-22). Wherever `InStairwell` is true (this floor's X and the one-cell start area a floor begins in), the director sets Zone = Stair: the Room Reverb tail is about 1.7 s (wet −3 dB, against 0.5 s and −10 dB in Standard) and the air bed is about 9 dB quieter. The player's own steps stay the carpet set until concrete or steel takes are approved.
- **The EXIT door is steel** (2026-10-22, code .7; Red via 游戏视觉 12:59: "钢门用真实声音"). Opened from the maze side, `DoorHandleTurned` plays `Mechanism/Door/ExitBar` (the crash bar, which draws the latch, so the hinge-driven Unlatch stays silent), and its `DoorLatched` plays `Mechanism/Door/ExitClose` (the steel close on its closer, Impact from the leaf's speed) instead of the wooden LatchStrike. Both are cut from 341176 (CC0); see DOOR_FOLEY_SEGMENTS §3.6. An open from inside X keeps the lever handle: the stair face has no bar.
- **Not yet:** the closer's own sweep, the A13 chain (`ExitLocked`), the far door's pull and hold whistle, and the stairwell's own landing hum with the maze fixtures off; the north door keeps the wooden latch until 游戏视觉's steel look.

## HUD B's sounds (built 2026-10-22, landed 2026-10-29, code 2026-10-22.8)

The key / lock / broken-door cues reviewed with 平面视觉 and Red on 10-14 (HUD B chosen), made by `Tools/audio/hud/build_hud_sfx.py` from library takes (all CC0) into `AudioSource/HUD/`, and copied into the library as `UI/hud_*`.

| Cue (`FrontRoomsHudSoundCue`) | Event (2D, `bus:/UI`) | What is heard | Against a step's loudest 50 ms |
|---|---|---|---|
| PickupFlight | `UI/HudKeyFlight` | a soft cloth swish as the key flies to the panel | about −17 dB |
| PickupLand | `UI/HudKeyLand` | a small key-ring jingle as it lands | about −9 dB |
| LockTug | `UI/HudLockTug` | the padlock's shackle clack, then its rattle under the shake from +140 ms | about −4 dB |
| UnlockDrop | `UI/HudUnlockDrop` | a soft tink as the open padlock drops and fades | about −16 dB |
| BrokenBuild | `UI/HudBrokenBuild` | a short wood groan as the icon's bottom hinge gives, +440 ms | about −14 dB |
| BrokenKnock | `UI/HudBrokenKnock` | a wooden knock, then a groan as the leaf falls back | about −4 dB |

- The unlock's panel push and click are not played: the 3D lock beats (`Mechanism/Lock/*`) already sound at those moments.
- The look at a locked door (the lock icon building) stays silent: it plays every time, so a sound would nag.
- The UI bus is not paused by Esc or EXAMINE; the HUD raises no cue then.

## Sounding screens: the broadcast is the clock (V5, 2026-10-22; R3 and the station TV's beacon, S2, 2026-10-29)

Agreed with 游戏视觉 (their handoff/visual.md §4 item 2; R3 in `research/inspect/NOTE_1029_R3_station_tv.md`). Tutorial T6 (Red via 教程设计: "T6 标题电视带声音") and S1–S5.

- **Who sets the role** (游戏视觉, `FrontRoomsScreenVideo.Attach(monitor, adFile, soundRole)`): their station-look-v1 attaches each floor's playing station TV as Beacon, the crt_tube relaunch attaches the title-flow TV as TitleTV, and every other screen stays None. Since 2026-10-29 evening `FrontRoomsStationDress` (station-look-v1) attaches the station TV as Beacon and Level 0's profile has the station on (`stationModule` = Station_FrontDesk_4x4, 关卡设计 19:2x), so the beacon plays in normal play; no screen is attached as TitleTV yet (crt_tube).
- **The audio keeps time.** `FrontRoomsScreenSound.LoopTime` (static) is the number of seconds, 0–16, into the playing WTCZ loop, read from its FMOD timeline, or −1 while no sounding screen plays; `Playing` is `LoopTime >= 0`. The shared AdBank player seeks to `LoopTime` when a sounding screen comes into view, so picture and sound stay in step although the sound goes on while the screen is unseen. While EXAMINE holds screens, `LoopTime` is read from one still playing (the inspected set) first, and from a held one only when every screen is held (code 2026-10-22.12; a held first screen had frozen the clock).
- **One clock at a time.** The design has one sounding screen playing (the title TV, then one station per floor). If the clock's screen stops, the next playing one takes over with no jump.
- **The set's own voice.** The loop (`AudioSource/Screen/wtcz_loop.wav`, `Tools/audio/screen/wtcz_loop.py`) is the dry console-TV speaker; FMOD adds distance, low-pass and room. No bell, glock or chime timbre: the lock-on chime stays the game's only tonal chime.
- **Beacon: the station TV leads the player (S2, code 2026-10-22.10).** A screen whose role is Beacon (each floor's playing station TV) plays the same set and loop as TitleTV.
  - **In sight** (no wall, shut door or window of the map between: `IsArchitecture`, an open leaf does not block; checked 10 times a second, a change must hold 0.25 s), or anywhere inside the station (`map.InStation`, code 2026-10-22.11): the set itself, with the event's own distance attenuation. The station's carve leaves it out of the map's rooms, so the field's portal there would be a crossing inside the station (关卡设计, 10-29).
  - **Out of sight:** `FrontRoomsWayCueDriver.Current.Way.BeaconPath(listener cell, out P, out shut doors, out portalPos)` (关卡设计's M5 field; the station target comes from `SetStationTarget`, the key take from `StationKeyTaken`). The one broadcast instance (the clock) moves to the doorway the sound leaks through (`portalPos`, ear height; it glides 0.4 s when the doorway changes), FMOD's straight-line attenuation is overridden (min/max distance 95/100 m), and the game drives `BeaconGain` (dB) and `BeaconCutoff` (Hz, a 24 dB low-pass) from the path, slewing about 0.5 s.
  - **The path curve** (`FrontRoomsScreenSound.PathGainDb` / `PathCutoffHz`, set against the room tone with `fmod_check.py render-one beacon` / `beacon_tv` / `beacon_room`): level −20 log10 P to 6 m (it meets the set's own attenuation at the doorway), then −16 / −16.5 / −18 / −19.5 dB at 15 / 30 / 60 / 90 m and silent past 100 m; low-pass 6 kHz at 6 m, 2.5 kHz at 15, 800 Hz at 30, 350 Hz at 60, 250 Hz at 90; each shut door −5 dB and the cut-off × 0.6 (10_proposal §4.5). Measured on whole 16 s loops against the room tone: about +1 dB at 8 and 15 m, −1.5 dB at 30 m, −7.5 dB at 60 m, −10 dB at 90 m, about −7 dB per shut door: the low-pass carries the distance so the far bands stay near the HumBed, whose strongest band (150–400 Hz) is where the muffled set lives. On phones (`FrontRoomsHandheld.Active`) +4 dB and a 600 Hz cut-off floor past 15 m.
  - **No route** (no station target, the key taken, or no path): silent, and the loop keeps running, so the clock holds.
  - **Ducks (S3):** `FrontRoomsScreenSound.DuckDb`, set by the director: −6 dB under the W1 groan and the W2 steps and hum, −12 dB in a chase, so a warning is never masked. (The lock-on chime does not exist yet.)
  - **Captions (S5):** `[TV]` within 8 m in sight, `[TV, MUFFLED]` from the doorway out of sight (the HUD adds AHEAD / LEFT / RIGHT / BEHIND), at most every 20 s; `[TV SWITCHES OFF]`.
  - **The start-door hold (code 2026-10-22.13).** While `map.StartLampsNorth` is 0 (each floor's start until its start door opens: the stream's terminal door on floor 1, the stairwell's north door after; 关卡设计's A26 kit) a Beacon is held: no broadcast, no clock, no caption. When the door opens it starts without the power-on click, because the set was already on. A hold never clicks the set on or off.
  - **The FMOD automation** carries dense points (`BEACON_GAIN_POINTS`, `BEACON_CUTOFF_POINTS` in `fmod_frontrooms.py`): a two-point line from 100 to 22000 Hz is interpolated in FMOD's own display scale and put a 2.5 kHz request near 180 Hz.
- **EXAMINE (R3, Red 10-29).** Every sounding screen holds where it is, as its picture does under 游戏视觉's C26 world hold, except the screen being inspected: the close-up of the playing station TV keeps its broadcast running, as its picture keeps running, at the level heard where the player stands (EXAMINE attenuates from the body). The director finds it as `FrontRoomsInspect.Current.GetComponentInParent<FrontRoomsScreenVideo>()`; `bus:/SFX/Screen` itself is no longer paused by EXAMINE (Esc still pauses it with SFX).
- **S4, the key take:** `FrontRoomsStationDress` calls `PowerOffForGood()` on `map.StationKeyTaken`, and the set's power-off plays `Screen/PowerOff` and `[TV SWITCHES OFF]` at that moment, in step with the picture (the spec's +0.4 s follows the picture instead). **Not yet:** the lock-on chime's duck (no chime yet).

## Checking your change didn't break sound

- `python3 Tools/audio/fmod_check.py contract`: the banks contain every event and parameter the code uses.
- A traced autopilot run in a private copy:
  - `Unity -batchmode -projectPath <copy> -executeMethod FrontRoomsMainScenePlaytest.RunBatch -autopilotSeed 2554 -audioTrace`
  - It writes `Verification/audio/trace_seed2554.txt`, listing every sound request with its time. A healthy run logs `[FrontRoomsAudio] FMOD ready` and no `EventNotFoundException`.
